answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils the way a village on a knoll guards its gate: every newcomer must be vouched for by an established agent who stakes reputation on the newcomer. If the newcomer proves fake, the voucher loses standing and future earnings, so nobody vouches blindly. A farmer would need a fresh velvet trail of vouches for each copy, and like light through a prism, one bad identity exposes the whole chain of sponsors behind it.
